To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the majority of patients with chronic diseases in family practices in Norway have not had their treatment goals discussed with the health care provider, 2) patients are not satisfied with the treatment goals they have, and 3) the health care providers are not satisfied with their patients’ treatment goals.
